metrics.profile_summary: Senior SEO professional with expertise in driving organic traffic growth through technical, on-page, and off-page optimization. Strong background in competitor analysis and data-driven performance reporting.

experience.description: Manages SEO for high-profile projects, conducting site audits, competitor analysis, and monthly performance reporting.
Executed link-building strategies, keyword research, and landing page optimization to increase conversions and organic visibility.
Researched industry trends and assisted in creating content and monthly calendars for social media platforms.

strengths: Basic familiarity with content calendars from internship
weaknesses: Core expertise is in SEO, not social media management
No mentioned experience with Meta Business Suite, Canva, or TikTok/IG publishing
Degree is in Computer Science rather than Marketing/Communications
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly qualified SEO specialist but lacks the specific social media management and creative tool experience required for this Marketing Specialist role.
